name: AGP
verdict: Double-glazing manufacturer, 75% owned by New Zealand's Profile Group, whose shares are held by Mitchell Plaw and co-holders. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: official partner of the Black Foils (SailGP team page, which links the AGP logo to agpl.co.nz; fetched 2026-09-30). Chain checked on the New Zealand Companies Register: Profile Group Limited holds 75% of Architectural Glass Products Limited and the other 25% sits with New Zealand private holders (a company, trustees and an individual); Profile Group Limited's shares are held by Mitchell Plaw, alone or with co-holders. No state or state fund in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against AGP or Profile Group found.
